def smd.gsLt (a b : GoString) : Bool :=
  smd.gsCompare a b == -1

def smd.lookupKV {α : Type} (k : GoString) : List (GoString × α) → Option α :=
  List.brecOn x✝ (smd.lookupKV._f k)

inductive smd.UVal : Type
  | smd.UVal.null : smd.UVal
  | smd.UVal.bool (b : Bool) : smd.UVal
  | smd.UVal.int (i : w64) : smd.UVal
  | smd.UVal.str (s : GoString) : smd.UVal
  | smd.UVal.list (vs : List smd.UVal) : smd.UVal
  | smd.UVal.map (kvs : List (GoString × smd.UVal)) : smd.UVal

def smd.UVal.brecOn.go.{u} {motive_1 : smd.UVal → Sort u} {motive_2 : List smd.UVal → Sort u}
    {motive_3 : List (GoString × smd.UVal) → Sort u} {motive_4 : GoString × smd.UVal → Sort u} (t :
    smd.UVal) (F_1 : (t : smd.UVal) → t.below → motive_1 t) (F_2 : (t : List smd.UVal) →
    smd.UVal.below_1 t → motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t : List (GoString × smd.UVal)) → smd.UVal.below_2 t →
    motive_3 t) (F_4 : (t : GoString × smd.UVal) → smd.UVal.below_3 t → motive_4 t) : motive_1 t ×'
    t.below :=
  smd.UVal.rec ⟨F_1 smd.UVal.null PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩ (fun b => ⟨F_1 (smd.UVal.bool b) PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩)
    (fun i => ⟨F_1 (smd.UVal.int i) PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩) (fun s => ⟨F_1 (smd.UVal.str s) PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩)
    (fun vs vs_ih => ⟨F_1 (smd.UVal.list vs) vs_ih, vs_ih⟩) (fun kvs kvs_ih => ⟨F_1 (smd.UVal.map kvs) kvs_ih, kvs_ih⟩)
    ⟨F_2 [] PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩
    (fun head tail head_ih tail_ih => ⟨F_2 (head :: tail) ⟨head_ih, tail_ih⟩, head_ih, tail_ih⟩)
    ⟨F_3 [] PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩
    (fun head tail head_ih tail_ih => ⟨F_3 (head :: tail) ⟨head_ih, tail_ih⟩, head_ih, tail_ih⟩)
    (fun fst snd snd_ih => ⟨F_4 (fst, snd) snd_ih, snd_ih⟩) t

def smd.mapStrIfaceTy : go.GoType :=
  go.string.MapType smd.ifaceTy

def smd.kvsOf {α : Type} (kvs : List (GoString × α)) : List (GoString × α) :=
  List.foldl
    (fun m x =>
      match x with
      | (k, v) => smd.insertKV k v m)
    [] kvs

def smd.UVal.decEq (a b : smd.UVal) : Decidable (a = b) :=
  x✝¹.brecOn smd.UVal.decEq._f smd.UVal.decEqL._f smd.UVal.decEqM._f (fun t f => PUnit.unit) x✝

    smd.UVal) : IProp GF

def smd.insertKV {α : Type} (k : GoString) (v : α) : List (GoString × α) → List (GoString × α) :=
  List.brecOn x✝ (smd.insertKV._f k v)

theorem smd.UVal.brecOn.eq.{u} {motive_1 : smd.UVal → Sort u} {motive_2 : List smd.UVal → Sort u}
    {motive_3 : List (GoString × smd.UVal) → Sort u} {motive_4 : GoString × smd.UVal → Sort u} (t :
    smd.UVal) (F_1 : (t : smd.UVal) → t.below → motive_1 t) (F_2 : (t : List smd.UVal) →
    smd.UVal.below_1 t → motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t : List (GoString × smd.UVal)) → smd.UVal.below_2 t →
    motive_3 t) (F_4 : (t : GoString × smd.UVal) → smd.UVal.below_3 t → motive_4 t) : t.brecOn F_1
    F_2 F_3 F_4 = F_1 t (smd.UVal.brecOn.go t F_1 F_2 F_3 F_4).2

def smd.UVal.compare (a b : smd.UVal) : Int :=
  smd.UVal.compareF (a.size + b.size + 1) a b

def smd.UVal.brecOn_3.go.{u} {motive_1 : smd.UVal → Sort u} {motive_2 : List smd.UVal → Sort u}
    {motive_3 : List (GoString × smd.UVal) → Sort u} {motive_4 : GoString × smd.UVal → Sort u} (t :
    GoString × smd.UVal) (F_1 : (t : smd.UVal) → t.below → motive_1 t) (F_2 : (t : List smd.UVal) →

    motive_3 t) (F_4 : (t : GoString × smd.UVal) → smd.UVal.below_3 t → motive_4 t) : motive_4 t ×'
    smd.UVal.below_3 t :=
  smd.UVal.rec_3 ⟨F_1 smd.UVal.null PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩ (fun b => ⟨F_1 (smd.UVal.bool b) PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩)
    (fun i => ⟨F_1 (smd.UVal.int i) PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩) (fun s => ⟨F_1 (smd.UVal.str s) PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩)
    (fun vs vs_ih => ⟨F_1 (smd.UVal.list vs) vs_ih, vs_ih⟩) (fun kvs kvs_ih => ⟨F_1 (smd.UVal.map kvs) kvs_ih, kvs_ih⟩)
    ⟨F_2 [] PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩
    (fun head tail head_ih tail_ih => ⟨F_2 (head :: tail) ⟨head_ih, tail_ih⟩, head_ih, tail_ih⟩)
    ⟨F_3 [] PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩
    (fun head tail head_ih tail_ih => ⟨F_3 (head :: tail) ⟨head_ih, tail_ih⟩, head_ih, tail_ih⟩)

def smd.UVal.ofMap (kvs : List (GoString × smd.UVal)) : smd.UVal :=
  smd.UVal.map (smd.kvsOf kvs)

def smd.instDecidableEqUVal : DecidableEq smd.UVal :=
  smd.UVal.decEq

def smd.sliceIfaceTy : go.GoType :=
  smd.ifaceTy.SliceType

def smd.boolCompare (a b : Bool) : Int :=
  if (a == b) = true then 0 else if (!a) = true then -1 else 1

def smd.intCompare (a b : w64) : Int :=
  if BitVec.toInt a > BitVec.toInt b then 1 else if (BitVec.toInt a == BitVec.toInt b) = true then 0 else -1

def smd.instInhabitedUVal.default : smd.UVal :=
  smd.UVal.null

def smd.isVal (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value) (x : smd.UVal) : IProp GF :=
  smd.isValF v DFrac.discard x
